CustomField.description: Auto-calculated SLA status based on Submission Deadline and Job Status. Used in list views and dashboards to highlight urgent jobs.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Filled"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Expired") ), "Closed", IF( ISBLANK(Submission_Deadline__c), "", IF( DATEVALUE(Submission_Deadline__c) < TODAY(), "Overdue", IF( DATEVALUE(Submission_Deadline__c) = TODAY(), "Due Today", "On Track" ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-calculated. On Track = deadline is future. Due Today = deadline is today. Overdue = deadline has passed but job still Open. Closed = job is Filled/Closed/Cancelled.
CustomField.label: SLA Status
